about_the_game:
This Tudor town is cursed with undercover werewolves. Work with the town to solve the mystery, or join the werewolves and deceive the town to destruction!

...Too much?
Opt out, relax and share a good conversation with some new friends. Playing is completely optional, after all - the real goal is bringing people together.

So come and play at your pace, make friends along the way and express yourself in our cosy interactive world for free!

Purchases are optional and only cosmetic.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 20.04, Ubuntu 18.04, and CentOS 7
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: OpenGL 3.2+ or Vulkan-capable, Nvidia and AMD GPUs.
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: High Sierra 10.13+
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Metal-capable Intel and AMD GPUs
  • Storage: 1 GB available space

name: Sweetlads' Werewolf

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows 7 (SP1+) and Windows 10
  • Processor: X64 architecture with SSE2 instruction set support
  • Memory: 1 GB RAM
  • Graphics: DX10, DX11, and DX12-capable GPUs
  • DirectX: Version 10
  • Storage: 1 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: Hardware vendor officially supported drivers

short_description: A casual take on the classic party game of deduction and deception best shared with 4-16 players online.
supported_languages: English, French, German, Korean, Portuguese - Brazil, Russian, Simplified Chinese, Spanish - Latin America
